prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one high-fidelity desktop web creator catalog decision comp, first viewport, landscape 16:9
Primary request: Design a production-grade SHUAMO creator offer catalog as a professional DEAL DESK: dense but calm, optimized for immediate product-offer comparison without losing place.
Input images: Image 1 is an identity reference only. Carry over its paper white, ink black, signal indigo, Geist-like sans and mono typography, fine neutral rules, compact controls, and restrained elevation. Do NOT copy its content, page sections, or layout.
Structure / framing: Show the operating UI edge-to-edge with no browser frame. Existing slim workspace navigation rail at far left, visually subordinate, about 72px wide. Next, a narrow searchable product-results column about 280px wide with a visible search field, fixed labeled PRODUCT TYPE filters, and compact product rows with real thumbnails. The selected row must say “Amber perfume 100ml” and be unmistakable through both a strong border and the words “Selected”, not color alone. The dominant center pane shows a large clean studio product preview of the selected amber perfume bottle, product name and concise catalog context, with a row of four thumbnail image selectors directly below; the active thumbnail has a border plus the word “Selected”. A persistent right offer inspector about 350px wide, separated by a fine rule, contains the decision terms in clear stacked rows: “12.5% commission”, “Estimated earnings”, “Eligible”, “30-day cookie”, “Payout timing”, “Allowed channels”, “Restrictions”. Include credible values without commercial claims: estimated earnings “12.50 ₾ per 100 ₾ sale”; payout timing “After confirmed conversion”; allowed channels “Instagram, TikTok, YouTube”; restrictions “No paid search · No self-referrals”. End with exactly one signal-indigo primary action labeled “Create tracking link”.
Scene / content: The UI is for creators evaluating product offers. Include a small factual label near the catalog header reading “Illustrative catalog data”. Show a few neighboring products in the results list for comparison, using restrained perfume, skincare, and accessory thumbnails; avoid ratings, sales counts, conversion rates, leaderboards, charts, or fake performance proof. A tiny footer note may say “On mobile, filters open in a sheet.” Do not show a mobile device mockup.
Style / medium: high-fidelity shippable SaaS operating interface, precise alignment, compact spacing, crisp readable labels, realistic clean product photography inside the UI, disciplined information hierarchy.
Color palette: paper white #FFFFFF, ink #111318, neutral slate rules and surfaces, one signal indigo #4436F5 used only for the single primary action and minimal focus/selection affordance. Status meaning must always be written, never color-only.
Typography: clean Geist-like sans for prose and labels; Geist-like mono with tabular figures for “12.5%” and “12.50 ₾”.
Lighting / mood: quiet daylight product imagery; overall calm, factual, professional.
Text (verbatim where visible): “SHUAMO”; “Deal desk”; “Products”; “Search products”; “Illustrative catalog data”; “PRODUCT TYPE”; “Amber perfume 100ml”; “Selected”; “Offer terms”; “12.5% commission”; “Estimated earnings”; “12.50 ₾ per 100 ₾ sale”; “Eligibility”; “Eligible”; “30-day cookie”; “Payout timing”; “After confirmed conversion”; “Allowed channels”; “Instagram, TikTok, YouTube”; “Restrictions”; “No paid search · No self-referrals”; “Create tracking link”; “On mobile, filters open in a sheet.”
Constraints: The experience must unmistakably read as an operating deal-desk UI, not a poster. Keep all four structural regions visible in the first viewport. Selection is obvious with words and border, not hue alone. One and only one indigo-filled action. No gradients. No glassmorphism. No fake performance metrics. No random bright colors. No browser chrome. No marketing hero composition. No oversized title. No floating decorative cards. No watermark.
